reference_sql:
WITH ranked AS (  -- one row per competitor check
  SELECT product_id, competitor,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY observed_ts DESC, competitor) AS rn
  FROM competitor_prices
)
SELECT competitor, COUNT(*) AS products
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY competitor
alternatives:
WITH latest AS (  -- one row per product with a check
  SELECT product_id, MAX(observed_ts) AS observed_ts
  FROM competitor_prices
  GROUP BY product_id
),
picks AS (  -- one row per product with a check
  SELECT cp.product_id, MIN(cp.competitor) AS competitor
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  JOIN latest l ON l.product_id = cp.product_id AND l.observed_ts = cp.observed_ts
  GROUP BY cp.product_id
)
SELECT competitor, COUNT(*) AS products
FROM picks
GROUP BY competitor

SELECT t.competitor, COUNT(*) AS products
FROM (
  -- one row per competitor check, numbered within its product from the latest
  SELECT product_id, competitor,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY observed_ts DESC, competitor) AS rn
  FROM competitor_prices
) AS t
WHERE t.rn = 1
GROUP BY t.competitor

),
picks AS (  -- one row per product with a check
  SELECT cp.product_id, MIN(cp.competitor) AS competitor
  FROM competitor_prices cp
  JOIN latest l ON l.product_id = cp.product_id AND l.observed_ts = cp.observed_ts
  GROUP BY cp.product_id
)
SELECT competitor, COUNT(*) AS products
FROM picks
GROUP BY competitor
other_way.tradeoff: The latest time per product, then the first competitor name at it, needs no window but takes two grouping steps.

SELECT competitor, COUNT(*) AS products FROM r WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY competitor
